daily_report_items: Published a 3,143-word standalone research podcast comparing PayPal's trend signal with valuation, Southern Copper and Vale's different copper exposures, and FANUC's automation recovery with payoff and liquidity limits. Current ratings remain PayPal Hold / Watch, Southern Copper Strong Sell / Avoid, Vale Hold / Watch, and FANUC Hold / Watch; no actionable signal or portfolio action was created.
